text:
elaine: Heads up — PRD draft uploaded: 'launch gates: minimal evidence for crypto + audit logs'. Need security + eng signoff by EOW. Main asks: KMS/HSM integration options, default audit-log retention, differences for Dedicated vs Private, and explicit acceptance criteria for SOC2/ISO. PTAL :eyes:
ajay: Ack. Quick Q: can you enumerate the API surfaces we expect to log? e.g., admin key ops, model load/unload, token issuance, data-plane calls?
maria: I skimmed — missing key lifecycle policy. We need to state whether HSM is required, recommended, or optional per deployment mode. SOC2 reviewers want documented rotation & revocation.
devon: Notes from runtime: Dedicated can integrate KMIP HSMs; hosted will need customer-managed KMS or an HSM-backed KMS offering. We'll call out `hosted: customer_kms` as a path, not platform-managed HSM.
elaine: Proposed acceptance criteria snippet (put into PRD):
```
- Audit logs MUST include: KMS key access events, key creation/deletion/rotation, model load/unload, admin API calls, and token issuance events.
- Timestamps MUST be timezone-normalized (ISO8601 UTC) and integrity-protected (checksums or signatures).
- Default retention: 90 days for hosted/Dedicated. Compliance add-on: configurable up to 7 years.
- Logs MUST be exportable to customer S3 with immutability/lock option.
- Redaction rule: redact PII and prompt content beyond first 256 chars unless customer opts-in.
- Acceptance artifact: reproducible e2e script that demonstrates key rotation -> log entry -> export.
```
sam: FYI ISO auditors look for tamper-evidence and timezone consistency. Add: log integrity verification step in acceptance.
maria: Edge case: emergency key compromise. PRD should include a documented revocation runbook + a test that simulates compromise and full revocation flow. Acceptance = runbook + passing test.
ajay: Perf tradeoff: logging every KV cache hit will explode volume. Suggest we classify events: `high-fidelity` (KMS ops, admin APIs) vs `aggregated` (per-token ops). Default keep high-fidelity, aggregate or sample the rest.
devon: Also need clear redaction guidance for embeddings/prompts. We can add a deterministic truncation + hash for longer prompts so you can correlate without storing text. Example: `prompt_hash = sha256(truncate(prompt,256))` in logs.
elaine: For scope negotiation: propose ship 90d default + compliance add-on (>=1y) behind sign-off and pricing. That keeps initial infra cost bounded. Thoughts?
maria: OK on scope model, but compliance customers need contract language. I'll draft required clauses (retention SLAs, exportability, revocation assistance).
ajay: One more acceptance criteria: locking of logs once written (WORM) for compliance customers. Is that something infra can support?
devon: We can support S3 Object Lock for exported logs. For internal stores, we'll implement append-only with signed offsets for tamper-evidence. We'll include a test that verifies immutability on export.
elaine: Action items: @maria to provide checklist items for PRD by EOD; @devon to outline minimal e2e harness and sample log schema; @ajay to draft redaction rules and sampling strategy; I'll update PRD with proposed acceptance criteria + scope note.
maria: I'll include revocation playbook and sample contract clauses.
elaine: OK scheduled follow-up tomorrow 10:00am in #eng-security to finalize launch gate evidence. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
